title: Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO Details
intro:
Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO is a book build issue of ₹42.44 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 34.00 lakh shares aggregating to ₹37.40 crores and offer for sale of 4.58 lakh shares aggregating to ₹5.04 crores.

Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO opens for subscription on Sep 25, 2026 and closes on Sep 29, 2026. The allotment for the Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 30, 2026. Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 5, 2026.

Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO is set issue price band at ₹104 to ₹110 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,64,000 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,96,000.

GYR Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Giriraj Stock Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2007, Bench Mark Infotech Services Limited is an integrated IT and digital infrastructure solutions company providing end-to-end technology infrastructure solutions to government departments, public sector undertakings, institutional customers, and private sector clients across India. The company specializes in turnkey execution of networking, communication systems, structured cabling, fibre optic infrastructure, surveillance systems, audio-visual solutions, data centre infrastructure, cloud solutions, and annual maintenance services.

The company operates through an integrated business model, offering complete project lifecycle services including system design, engineering, procurement, installation, commissioning, system integration, testing, maintenance, and after-sales support. It also provides fibre optic network execution, dark fibre leasing, cloud computing, virtualization, data storage solutions, and AI-enabled edge computing infrastructure.

The company have also initiated the offerings towards Artificial Intelligence (AI) Lab Solutions, including setting up of AI labs andprovidingedge computing nodes and related infrastructure for AI, machine learning and other computing applications, including AI laboratories,GPU-enabled computing platforms, enterprise storage, high-performance networking, and AI-ready data infrastructure
As of June 30, 2026, the company employed 54 professionals across operations, engineering, design, marketing, finance, procurement, and administration.
strengths: Integrated end-to-end IT and digital infrastructure solutions under a single-roof execution model.
Established track record of executing diverse networking, fibre optic, surveillance, and system integration projects.
Long-standing customer relationships with repeat order flow from government and institutional clients.
Strong relationships with leading OEMs and authorized technology vendors.
Experienced promoter and management team with over 19 years of industry expertise.

faqs.question: How to apply in Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Bench Mark Infotech Services IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
